youtube.title: Operation Northwoods: The Military's Plan to Fake Attacks on America (Full Case File)
youtube.description:
In March 1962, the US Joint Chiefs of Staff approved a top-secret memo titled "Justification for US Military Intervention in Cuba." It proposed staging attacks at Guantanamo, blowing up a US ship and blaming Cuba, a fake Cuban terror campaign in Miami and Washington, and faking the shoot-down of a chartered airliner. Chairman Lyman Lemnitzer presented it to Defense Secretary Robert McNamara on 13 March 1962. President Kennedy rejected the use of military force, and none of it happened. The memo stayed secret until the Assassination Records Review Board released it on 18 November 1997. This documentary reads the real memo, page by page.
